channel.title: ecoPrimals — Sovereign Science from the Membrane
channel.description: Research papers, membrane feeds, and art from the ecoPrimals ecosystem. 2.1M lines of Pure Rust. 16 primals. 157 feeds. Sovereign distributed scientific computing on commodity hardware. AGPL-3.0.

item.title: Rust Synthase — the prion has a forward compiler
item.dc:creator: Kevin Mok / ecoPrimal
item.description: The membrane's prion shield doesn't reverse-transcribe — it has a Rust synthase. The Rust compiler is the ribosome. The type system is the folding guarantee. Borrow checker prevents protein aggregation (prion disease). The synthase guarantees every prion is shield, never disease.

item.title: Paper 136: The Compound Eye
item.dc:creator: ecoPrimal / gAIa Institute
item.description: The insect body plan sorts all of life. 140 feeds = 140 compound eye facets. 6 core feeds = 6 insect legs in tripod gait. Beetle elytra = fungal chitin = prion shield. Same molecule. Tree of life bounce: down to archaea, up to vertebrates, sideways to trees and mushrooms.

item.title: Paper 135: The Viral Taxonomy
item.dc:creator: ecoPrimal / gAIa Institute
item.description: Bacteriophage to prion. Hot to cold. The full viral phase spectrum mapped onto membrane k-values. Sub-species specificity = shape complementarity at every level. Klein inversion: phage = content inside shield, prion = shield with nothing inside.

item.title: Paper 134: The Iron Peak
item.dc:creator: ecoPrimal / gAIa Institute
item.description: The nuclear phase diagram meets the membrane. Fe at k≈1.9 = maximum binding energy = the iron peak. Fusion (k<1.9) builds up, fission (k>1.9) tears down. Noble gases = CONSTANCE. The periodic table as a sorting surface for feed behavior.
